_comment: Failures recorded so the suite fails on NEW regressions rather than on an
existing backlog. Remove an id when its bug is fixed — the runner reports
an entry that starts passing, so this list cannot rot silently.
unmodelled_kind: DBDiff produces NO diff while the schemas genuinely
differ, because it does not model that object kind at all. These are
feature gaps, and the more dangerous class: a user sees 'no drift' and
wrong_output: DBDiff produces a diff, but applying it does not reproduce
the target schema. These are defects in existing behaviour.
